title: Modern Periodic Law and Modern Periodic Table
notes: **Modern periodic law (Moseley, 1913):** the properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers.
**Why atomic number, not mass:** Moseley showed that X-ray frequencies depend on atomic number, not atomic mass. Argon (Z=18, A=40) and potassium (Z=19, A=39) are in the correct order by Z, not A.
**Periodic table layout:** 7 periods and 18 groups. Period number equals the principal quantum number of the valence shell. Group number relates to valence electron count for main-group elements.
**Blocks:** s-block (Groups 1-2), p-block (Groups 13-18), d-block (transition metals, Groups 3-12), f-block (lanthanides and actinides, placed below main table).
**Periodicity:** elements in the same group have similar chemical properties because they have the same valence electron configuration.
